title: AI Is Choosing Your Customers' Vendors
transcript: Every 10 years, the internet has a shift that mints a new generation of millionaires. The first two created billion-dollar companies. The third one just started. And most business owners haven't even noticed. Let me show you the pattern. The first shift was desktop SEO. Google launched, and the businesses that figured out how to rank early dominated their categories for a decade. Some of them still do. The second was mobile. Smartphones changed how people search, and the brands that went mobile first captured market share that their competitors never got back. We're now in the third shift, AI agents. Your next customer isn't browsing your website. Their AI is, pulling your data, comparing you against 30 competitors [music] in seconds, picking who gets the sale before a human ever sees your page. The pattern is identical. The window to win is not. So, you have to move fast because desktop SEO took 5 to 10 years to mature. Mobile took five. AI agents are getting adopted in 12 to 18 months. Once they learn which brands to recommend in a category, those recommendations compound. The more they recommend you, the more data they get on you. The more data, the more authority. The more authority, the more recommendations. It's a flywheel. The brands that get on it first spin faster each and every single [music] day. The ones that wait are fighting uphill against competitors who are already the default. So, you can figure out where you stand by going to ubersuggest.com and see if AI tools are recommending you within your categories that you're competing right now. If you're not in the recommendations, that's your starting point. Two shifts already minted the winners. The third one is still open. Don't wait this one out.
